what: How Bitcoin's blockspace splits between the kinds of use, day by day: for each UTC day, the bytes (size) and the number of transactions of each kind, read from every block's own bytes by the Block Manifest's reader. A transaction that is several kinds at once is counted under the first that fits, in this order: runes, BRC-20, Alkanes, Stamps & Counterparty, other tokens, inscriptions, messages, coinbase, consolidations, batch payouts, payments. "block header" is each block's header and transaction count, so the kinds add up to the bytes read (size). notRead lists any block that could not be read: its bytes are not in the day. Bitcoin only.
